patch.summary: Change a member’s role or team

delete.summary: Remove a member; their principal is revoked so it can’t spend

patch.summary: Rename, change the limit or mode, set alerts, or archive

A scope’s active policy and its version history

put.summary: Publish a new version of a scope’s policy
put.description: Versions are immutable. Pass `expectedVersion` (0 for a scope with no policy yet) to fail with 409 instead of overwriting someone else’s change.

post.summary: What would happen if this principal attempted this action now?
post.description: Uses the active org, team and principal policies; `drafts` replace them to test changes before publishing.
